SafetyAgent.text: The system shall ensure that no member can borrow more than 5 books simultaneously.
SafetyAgent.rationale: This limits the risk of overwhelming the system with excessive transactions and ensures fair access to resources.

SafetyAgent.text: The system shall automatically track and notify members of overdue books within 24 hours of the due date.
SafetyAgent.rationale: Prompt notifications enhance accountability and encourage timely returns, reducing the risk of resource unavailability.

SafetyAgent.text: The system shall maintain real-time inventory status of all books to prevent double borrowing.
SafetyAgent.rationale: Real-time tracking reduces the risk of confusion or errors in book availability, enhancing reliability.

SafetyAgent.text: The system shall provide a backup mechanism to recover all transaction data in case of a failure.
SafetyAgent.rationale: Data recovery ensures continued operation and safety of member information and borrowing history.

SafetyAgent.text: The system shall allow librarians to revoke borrowing privileges for members with outstanding overdue books.
SafetyAgent.rationale: This enforcement helps maintain system integrity and promotes responsible usage among members.

SafetyAgent.text: The system shall implement a user authentication process to ensure only registered members can access borrowing features.
SafetyAgent.rationale: Authentication safeguards member data and reduces the risk of unauthorized access to the system.

SafetyAgent.text: The system shall log all transactions, including borrow and return actions, for audit purposes.
SafetyAgent.rationale: Transaction logging enhances accountability and allows for performance monitoring, contributing to system reliability.

EfficiencyAgent.text: The system shall enable searching for books with a response time of under 2 seconds for 95% of queries.
EfficiencyAgent.rationale: Fast search response times enhance user experience and system efficiency.

EfficiencyAgent.text: The system shall allow up to 10 simultaneous book borrow operations per member to optimize resource utilization.
EfficiencyAgent.rationale: Setting a borrowing limit ensures efficient management of library resources.

EfficiencyAgent.text: The system shall track book availability and update the status in real-time to ensure accurate information.
EfficiencyAgent.rationale: Real-time tracking minimizes confusion and improves operational efficiency.

EfficiencyAgent.text: The system shall process book returns within 1 second to maintain high throughput.
EfficiencyAgent.rationale: Quick processing of returns maximizes system throughput and member satisfaction.

EfficiencyAgent.text: The system shall send overdue notifications to members within 24 hours of the due date to ensure accountability.
EfficiencyAgent.rationale: Timely notifications improve resource management and member compliance.

EfficiencyAgent.text: The system shall enable librarians to add or remove books with a latency of less than 3 seconds per operation.
EfficiencyAgent.rationale: Minimizing latency in administrative tasks enhances overall system performance.

EfficiencyAgent.text: The system shall maintain an uptime of 99.5% to ensure consistent availability for users.
EfficiencyAgent.rationale: High availability is critical for maintaining user trust and operational efficiency.

GreenAgent.text: The library management system shall minimize energy consumption by using energy-efficient servers and infrastructure.
GreenAgent.rationale: Reducing energy consumption aligns with sustainability goals and decreases the overall carbon footprint.

GreenAgent.text: The system shall provide an energy usage report for library operations at least quarterly.
GreenAgent.rationale: Regular monitoring of energy usage helps identify areas for improvement in efficiency.

GreenAgent.text: The library management system shall enable digital notifications for overdue books to reduce paper waste.
GreenAgent.rationale: Utilizing digital communications supports sustainability by minimizing resource use.

GreenAgent.text: The system shall allow members to check the carbon footprint of each book based on its lifecycle impact.
GreenAgent.rationale: Educating members about the carbon footprint raises awareness and promotes sustainable borrowing choices.

GreenAgent.text: The library management system shall implement a recycling program for damaged books, ensuring proper disposal.
GreenAgent.rationale: A recycling program reduces lifecycle resource impact and promotes sustainable practices.

GreenAgent.text: The system shall track the total energy savings achieved through digital operations compared to traditional methods.
GreenAgent.rationale: Tracking energy savings offers measurable insights into the effectiveness of sustainability efforts.

GreenAgent.text: The library management system shall prioritize the acquisition of e-books to reduce physical resource consumption.
GreenAgent.rationale: Acquiring more e-books supports resource efficiency and minimizes the carbon footprint associated with physical books.

TrustworthinessAgent.text: The system shall ensure that only authenticated members can borrow or return books.
TrustworthinessAgent.rationale: This ensures access control to prevent unauthorized borrowing or returning of library materials.

TrustworthinessAgent.text: The system shall log all borrowing transactions for auditability purposes.
TrustworthinessAgent.rationale: Logging transactions allows for tracking and reviewing actions taken within the system, enhancing security.

TrustworthinessAgent.text: The system shall enforce data encryption for all member personal information stored.
TrustworthinessAgent.rationale: Data encryption protects member privacy and confidentiality against unauthorized access.

TrustworthinessAgent.text: The system shall implement role-based access control for librarians and members.
TrustworthinessAgent.rationale: Role-based access control ensures that only authorized personnel can perform sensitive operations.

TrustworthinessAgent.text: The system shall provide a mechanism to report and manage overdue books securely.
TrustworthinessAgent.rationale: Secure handling of overdue books management protects data integrity and member interactions.

TrustworthinessAgent.text: The system shall allow members to update their personal information securely.
TrustworthinessAgent.rationale: This requirement ensures that members can manage their own data while maintaining its integrity.

TrustworthinessAgent.text: The system shall require strong password policies for member accounts.
TrustworthinessAgent.rationale: Strong password policies help safeguard member accounts against unauthorized access and enhance overall system security.

ResponsibilityAgent.text: The system shall ensure compliance with data protection regulations by implementing encryption for all member data.
ResponsibilityAgent.rationale: This requirement addresses the ethical concern of protecting personal information in compliance with regulations.

ResponsibilityAgent.text: The system shall provide an accessible interface for all users, including those with disabilities, to promote fairness and inclusivity.
ResponsibilityAgent.rationale: This requirement ensures that the library system is fair and accessible to all members of the community.

ResponsibilityAgent.text: The system shall log all user actions related to book borrowing and returning for accountability.
ResponsibilityAgent.rationale: This requirement enhances accountability by providing a clear record of interactions with the system.

ResponsibilityAgent.text: The system shall adhere to library borrowing policies by enforcing a maximum of 5 books per member.
ResponsibilityAgent.rationale: This requirement ensures fairness in resource distribution among library members.

ResponsibilityAgent.text: The system shall automatically notify members of overdue books via email to promote responsibility.
ResponsibilityAgent.rationale: This requirement encourages members to return books on time, fostering a sense of social responsibility.

ResponsibilityAgent.text: The system shall implement a feedback mechanism for members to report issues or suggestions regarding fairness in library services.
ResponsibilityAgent.rationale: This requirement promotes ongoing accountability and responsiveness to user concerns.

ResponsibilityAgent.text: The system shall provide an annual report on usage statistics to ensure transparency in library operations.
ResponsibilityAgent.rationale: This requirement supports social responsibility by making library operations transparent to the community.
